daly_gran.text: That hurley over the fire was my father's. We touch it for luck before the big matches, whether it is working or not.
In spring, if you see two hares boxing, it is usually the lady fending off the gentleman. Do not blame the hare.
Bad news about the weather, 'tis 'lashing' out there. In Kilkenny that means raining hard, not being generous.
